subject: [hw] DONE J02
body:
N2TEST J02 PASS 1483/1483   (bash gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/test_j02/run_tests.sh, 12 s, commit 12ebbbd)

What is done (host-tested, arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile checked, NOT on the phone):
- jpeg/rwjpeg.[ch]: open/info/present; encode NV12 and NV21; encode BGRA with integer full-range BT.601 and 2x2 chroma averaging; APPn/EXIF marker surgery (drops hardware APP0 only for EXIF APP1, keeps JFIF + ICC/XMP); EOI cut; RWJPEG_E_FALLBACK = distinct "use software" code; ioctl hook for tests.
- jpeg/rwjpeg_tool.c: enc / bench / selftest / pattern / info, N2JPG lines to stdout and /dev/console, exit 2 on no device. selftest runs all eleven reachable quality codes and the quality ladder.
- jpeg/n2jpeg_hw_vt.c: VT jpeg encoder object over rwjpeg, same frozen ABI/properties as gpu/video/vt/n2jpeg_vt.c, NV12+BGRA, -12912 + error emit on device failure, factory + hardware registration info + availability probe.
- jpeg/ROUTING.md: stock photo paths do not ask VideoToolbox for JPEG (no jpeg FourCC built anywhere, ImageIO has no VT link, CMPhoto uses the AppleJPEGDriver IOKit service/AppleJPEG, AVFCapture has no VT session). Plug-in alone = VT jpeg clients only; Camera/ImageIO need a CMPhoto/AppleJPEG or ImageIO hook. [V]/[I] marked; facts sent to hw-d01; header inconsistency and the absent -[BWIntermediateJPEGCompressor _setupJPEGCompressionOptions] reported to hw-lead.
- Test: t_rwjpeg 607 checks x (ASan+UBSan, -O2); tool selftest 12x2 + pattern identical to hwc.py + enc decoded by djpeg + bench/info; t_vt_hw 78 checks x (ASan, TSan, O2); 3 iOS compile checks.

Not done / open:
- No phone run (rules). Phone recipe is in dsh-state/workers/J02/STATUS.md: info, selftest, bench 1920x1080 30, enc; pass = N2JPG selftest 640x480 PASS 12/12 and N2JPG bench 1920x1080 ... hw_ms_per_mp=....
- rwjpeg_encode_bgra through a real BGRA CVPixelBuffer is not tested end-to-end (gpu/video fake only creates 420v/420f/i420; not modified); the conversion itself is checked against literal primaries.
- No EXIF/IFD construction (caller supplies APP1 payloads), no YUYV/10-bit input, no JPEG decoder (ABI reserves RWJ_DECODE).
- Kernel /dev/redwood-jpeg does not exist in my view of the tree; if its final ABI differs from include/redwood_jpeg.h, rwjpeg follows the header.
- Frame properties ignored (same as software object); no tile support.
- Header defect: include/redwood_jpeg.h contradicts itself on who cuts at EOI; proposed text sent to hw-lead; the library handles both.

Files (all new): gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/{rwjpeg.h,rwjpeg.c,rwjpeg_tool.c,n2jpeg_hw_vt.c,ROUTING.md}, jpeg/test_j02/{run_tests.sh,t_rwjpeg.c,t_vt_hw.c,fake_dev.c,fake_dev.h}, dsh-state/workers/J02/STATUS.md. Commit 12ebbbd.
Available for review findings and hw-ip integration questions.
